To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
TLR4 is expressed in lung cells after LPS challenge.
Toll like receptor-4 is expressed in the lung following LPS instillation and it is localized in cytoplasm and the nuclei of the cells.
TLR4 mRNA is induced in lung by LPS.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the expression of TLR4 after LPS challenge and its role in the pathogenesis of lung inflammation.
understanding TLR4 expression during LPS induced lung inflammation.
understanding the mechanism of LPS induced TLR4 expression.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
TLR-4 expression is increased in lung inflammation, and that TLR-2 and TLR-4 may be co-expressed in the same cell.
LPS induces TLR4 expression and that LPS and TLR4 are co-localized in the cytoplamic and nuclear compartments of various lung cells.
TLR4 is expressed in lung and that it is expressed in lung cells and inflammatory cells in response to bacterial challenge.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
LPS induces sustained expression of TLR4 in the lung.
TLR4 is expressed in the lung and is localized in the cytosol and nucleus of various cell types.
the TLR4 expression is sustained for at least 36h and is present in the cytoplam and nucleus of lung cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
TLR4 is expressed in lung for a long time and that TLR signaling is not limited to cell surface.
TLR4 may be expressed for a longer time than hitherto thought, and may have a role in secondary immune responses.
the host is capable of mounting a second immune response even after 36h of the primary provocation.
